categories.main_business_segments: Geovis Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in aerospace information technology, commercial aerospace industry integration, and low-altitude economy development. Its main business includes software sales and data services, technical development and services, specialized equipment manufacturing, and system integration. The company focuses on satellite-based capabilities, airborne capabilities, and cloud-based aerospace information services, serving government, special sectors, enterprises, and public users.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced aerospace technologies including satellite remote sensing, intelligent satellite constellation control, digital earth platforms, and cloud computing. Key technologies include cross-scale remote sensing models, multi-source data fusion for digital twin reconstruction, intelligent agent technology for digital earth applications, 3D grid-based low-altitude airspace digital construction, and large-scale real-time safety computation for low-altitude aircraft. It also develops modular aerospace electronic systems and integrates AI-driven cloud services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government agencies, special sectors (such as defense and emergency management), enterprises in energy, finance, and smart parks, and public users. The company serves industries like meteorology, natural resources, urban management, agriculture, and aerospace. It also targets emerging markets in commercial aerospace and low-altitude economy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant business in regions including North China, East China, Central China, Southwest, Northwest, South China, and Northeast China. It has subsidiaries and operations in major Chinese cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, Hefei, Nanjing, Xi'an, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: Geovis operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace information supply chain. It focuses on satellite data processing, aerospace measurement and control, cloud-based data services, and application development, while also expanding upstream into satellite constellation operations and aerospace electronic system manufacturing through investments and acquisitions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing commercial aerospace full-industry chain capabilities, enhancing low-altitude economy technologies, and building integrated aerospace-cloud platforms. R&D priorities include AI-driven remote sensing models, digital twin technologies, intelligent satellite control, and large-scale real-time computation for airspace safety. It emphasizes innovation in cloud services, ecosystem development, and expanding applications across industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through software product sales, data service subscriptions, technical development and consulting services, specialized equipment sales, and system integration projects. The company also adopts cloud service subscription models, direct sales of standardized products, and customized value-added services to diversify income streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Geovis is positioned as a leading innovator and integrator in China's aerospace information technology sector, holding a top ranking among geographic information industry companies. It competes with domestic and international aerospace and geospatial data service providers, leveraging its comprehensive capabilities across satellite data, cloud computing, and AI to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.26 billion, a 29.49% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 351.7 million, up 2.67%. Total assets grew by 37.49% to over RMB 8.29 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by increased R&D investment and strategic acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Geovis emphasizes its unique integration of satellite-based and airborne aerospace information capabilities with advanced cloud computing and AI technologies. Its proprietary digital earth platform and intelligent satellite control systems provide high-precision, real-time data and services. The company’s comprehensive ecosystem approach, including developer platforms and open service portals, differentiates it by enabling broad industry applications and fostering innovation across commercial aerospace and low-altitude economy sectors.
